title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to show or hide subform fields based on a value in the main page
summary: This post explains how to dynamically show or hide subform fields based on a value in the main page of a Sales Order, using a custom field and page extension logic in AL code to create a responsive user interface.
key_points: Add a custom Boolean field to the main page (Sales Header) to control visibility state
Use page extensions to modify subform fields and implement a SetShowItemInfo procedure
Implement OnValidate and OnOpenPage triggers to update field visibility in real time when the main page field changes
The example demonstrates hiding or showing Item No., Item Reference No., and Description fields in the Sales Order Subform

quotes.text: In Dynamics 365 Business Central development, creating a responsive UI is key to a great user experience.
quotes.why_it_matters: Sets the context that dynamic UI control is essential for user experience in Business Central development
